name: Inventors of the South Tigris

categories.label: Guild majorities
categories.hint: Most Influence in each Guild scores the higher printed VP, second most the lower; each Tent in the 3 left Tenting areas counts as 2 Influence.

categories.label: Royalties track
categories.hint: VP printed next to spaces 4 and higher.

categories.label: Research tiles
categories.hint: Each Influence along the River scores its printed amount.

categories.label: Craftspeople
categories.hint: VP on the right edge of each Tower Tile, active or inactive.

categories.label: Workshop tiles
categories.hint: All VP printed on collected Workshop Tiles.

categories.label: Invention tiles
categories.hint: Uncovered VP on player boards where invention tiles were removed.

categories.label: Builder & publisher influence
categories.hint: Built: 1 VP per Testing Die. Published with 2 different Influence: Builder 3 VP, Publisher 1 VP per die. Same player both: 1 VP + 1 per die.

categories.label: Built & published devices
categories.hint: 0, 2 or 4 VP per device by its scoring condition; counted twice if one player is Builder and Publisher.

categories.label: Silver + Device cards left
categories.labelVi: Bạc + bài thiết bị còn lại
categories.hint: Every 4 in any combination = 1 VP. Enter the combined count.

categories.label: Ship position (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Ships further right win ties; same space: lower ship is ahead. Enter rank order, higher = better.

tiebreakers.description: Ship further right on the River wins; if sharing a space, the lower ship is ahead

notes: family: area-majority. Game ends after all players raise their last Tent in the final Round (3 or 4 Rounds). Dummy Player in 2p competes for guild majorities. Solo mode (win by outscoring the automa opponent) not modelled. Device scoring condition thresholds are printed on device boards.
